record.field: Find what public complaint boards say about a phone number.

Search the web for the number in its international and national formats alongside spam, scam and caller terms. Treat every search result as a candidate. Fetch only pages on known complaint boards, and cite a page only when it names the number. Reject results from any other site. Conclude when the candidate boards have been fetched; close as not found when no complaint-board page names the number.
